title: The Signature Approach to Zero-Latency Cloud Processing (Signature)
provenance: Signature original design work by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled original designs and improvements — original work, not presented as established public fact.
description: The Signature approach treats latency as a product spec: edge everywhere, prediction as standard, deterministic paths on demand, and perceived-latency benchmarks. The cloud stops feeling remote. This is Signature original work by Justin Addam Higgins: an original design direction for Zero-Latency Cloud Processing, labeled as Signature throughout, and never presented as established public fact. Signature zero-latency ships as a guarantee: every metro with edge GPUs, every app with a latency budget, every user within 5 ms of compute. Distance stops mattering.

Signature vision: Signature zero-latency ships as a guarantee: every metro with edge GPUs, every app with a latency budget, every user within 5 ms of compute.
Original work: designed by Justin Addam Higgins, Signature-labeled throughout.
Ladder rank 1 — the Signature foundation for this technology.
